capability.name: Shopping Cart and Checkout
capability.description: Manages the customer purchase journey from adding products to completing payment.

features.name: Add Item to Cart
features.description: Allows a customer to add a selected product to the shopping cart before checkout.

features.name: Cart Contents Review
features.description: Allows a customer to view the current products in the shopping cart before or during checkout.

features.name: Increase Cart Item Quantity
features.description: Allows a customer to increase the quantity of an existing item in the shopping cart.

features.name: Decrease Cart Item Quantity
features.description: Allows a customer to decrease the quantity of an existing item in the shopping cart.

features.name: Remove Cart Item
features.description: Allows a customer to remove an item from the shopping cart.

features.name: Billing Details Capture
features.description: Captures customer billing details required during checkout.

features.name: Address Details Capture
features.description: Captures customer address details required during checkout. Postcode lookup may be a supporting dependency based on the supplied local mock context.
dependencies: Postcode lookup service or local mock

features.name: Checkout Sign-In
features.description: Supports or requires customer sign-in during checkout. Supplied evidence confirms checkout sign-in involvement but does not clarify whether it is mandatory or optional.

features.name: Basic Payment Options
features.description: Supports available basic payment options during checkout. Supplied evidence does not identify the specific payment methods.

features.name: Advanced Payment Options
features.description: Supports available advanced payment options during checkout. Supplied evidence does not identify the specific advanced payment methods.

features.name: Web Checkout Completion
features.description: Allows a customer to complete the checkout journey through the web experience after cart review, required checkout details, and payment option handling.

features.name: Mobile Checkout Completion
features.description: Allows a customer to complete the checkout journey through the mobile experience after cart review, required checkout details, and payment option handling.
